name: Latitude — Taj Dal View
why_it_matters: Taj Dal View's all-day dining room with panoramic glass over the lake and Zabarwan ridge. International + Kashmiri menu plus a traditional traami feast served in a shamiyana tent on request — the most production-value Wazwan in any Srinagar hotel.
insider_tip: The traami requires advance booking (24-48 hrs) and a minimum cover; ordinary à la carte dinners are walk-in. The trout comes from a farm a short drive from the property — order it grilled, not fried.
signature_address: Taj Dal View, Kralsangri, Brein, Srinagar 191121

name: Jade Dragon — Taj Dal View
signature_dish: chicken in Sichuan black bean sauce
why_it_matters: Srinagar's only proper Sichuan-leaning Chinese restaurant, set inside Taj Dal View. Intimate room with a separate menu from Latitude — useful when you've had three nights of wazwan and want a clean break.
insider_tip: The kitchen goes genuinely spicy on request — Indian palate-tuning is the default, so ask for 'Sichuan-level heat' if you want it actual. Lotus stem honey chilli is the dish even non-Chinese eaters return for.
signature_address: Taj Dal View, Kralsangri, Brein, Srinagar 191121

name: Firdaus — Radisson Collection Riverfront
signature_dish: Al Hach Te Koker (collard greens with chicken)
why_it_matters: Signature restaurant of Radisson Collection's first India property (212 rooms on the Jhelum, opened 2024). Menu helmed by Chef Rakesh Sethi, a National Award winner who has cooked for Indian presidents — the Wazwaan reads as research-grade rather than tourist-grade.
insider_tip: Try the Shufta — a dried-fruit dessert most hotels skip. It's the kitchen's quiet calling-card and rarely seen on a la carte menus elsewhere in town.
signature_address: Radisson Collection Hotel & Spa Riverfront, Boulevard Road, Rajbagh, Srinagar
